rule: Do not fabricate resolved outcome labels. Macro-average pricing Brier requires resolved y in {0,1} per domain.

domains.label_definition: Pass/Distinction vs Fail/Withdrawn by course end
domains.leakage_controls: checkpoint event_day <= t; no final result / future VLE / future assessments

candidates_considered: Public hiring funnel panels with offer outcomes (generally private / proprietary)
LeetCode contest rankings (not a personal goal contract with deadline + binary success)
evaluation_without_labels: Goal Architect schema / no invented odds
Model-consistent policy regret under hiring simulator (not causal ATE)

candidates_considered: Lending Club / consumer loan default (population credit risk, not personal net-worth goal contracts)
Public market OHLC (asset price, not individual savings-goal resolution)
domains.note: Product uses mechanistic net-worth simulation; no held-out personal savings-goal panel loaded.

candidates_considered: Public race results without individual training history at prediction time t
Strava / Garmin exports (private user data; not a frozen public labeled panel)
Crunchbase funding outcomes (firm-level; sparse personal goal contracts; severe selection bias)
Habit-tracking app dumps (typically private; outcome definitions inconsistent)

macro_average_pricing.reason: Only education has resolved binary goal outcomes under a frozen no-leakage protocol.
macro_average_pricing.honest_reporting: Report education pricing metrics separately; report agent/decision metrics by domain; do not claim K/K domain pricing wins.

action_impact_causal.reason: No randomized or credible quasi-experimental personal-action panel with treatment variation and outcomes is loaded.
action_impact_causal.proxy_used: Model-consistent What If uplift + policy regret under the product's numerical simulator, clearly labeled non-causal.
